== Participants ==
A total of 16 players played in this division.

Virus sadly had to drop from the tournament after moving houses and had no internet connection.


Some controversy occurred during the Grand Final where both players thought they were done after Baresi won 3-1.
VVD came on server and told them to play another bo5 which was not specified in the rules.

Defcon 5 was unwilling to play further that night and the second bo5 was scheduled for another day.
